description: This file implements a menu box interface as part of a dialog library, including functions for rendering menu items, handling user input, and managing scrolling within a text-based UI.

methods.name: void do_print_item(WINDOW * win,const char * item,int line_y,int selected,int hotkey)
methods.description: Prints a single menu item to a window at specified position, highlighting if selected, and marking hotkeys.

methods.name: void print_arrows(WINDOW * win,int item_no,int scroll,int y,int x,int height)
methods.description: Displays scroll indicators (arrows) above and below the menu items based on current scroll position.

methods.name: void print_buttons(WINDOW * win,int height,int width,int selected)
methods.description: Displays action buttons ('Select', 'Exit', 'Help', 'Save', 'Load') at the bottom of the dialog.

methods.name: void do_scroll(WINDOW * win,int * scroll,int n)
methods.description: Scrolls the menu window up or down by a specified number of lines.

methods.name: int dialog_menu(const char * title,const char * prompt,const void * selected,int * s_scroll)
methods.description: Main function that displays a menu dialog, handles user input for navigation, selection, and other actions, and returns the chosen option.

ctags.name: dialog_menu
ctags.signature: (const char * title,const char * prompt,const void * selected,int * s_scroll)

ctags.name: do_print_item
ctags.pattern: /^static void do_print_item(WINDOW * win, const char *item, int line_y,$/
ctags.signature: (WINDOW * win,const char * item,int line_y,int selected,int hotkey)

ctags.name: print_arrows
ctags.pattern: /^static void print_arrows(WINDOW * win, int item_no, int scroll, int y, int x,$/
ctags.signature: (WINDOW * win,int item_no,int scroll,int y,int x,int height)

ctags.name: print_buttons
ctags.pattern: /^static void print_buttons(WINDOW * win, int height, int width, int selected)$/
